verdict.rationale: A/B testing is a fair axis for an email marketing platform, but the evidence pack never mentions split testing of subject lines or content, or automatic winner selection. Dynamic subject-line personalisation, send-time scheduling and per-campaign click reports are adjacent features, not A/B testing, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can A/B test subject lines or content variants and have the winner picked from real engagement
